workflow_metadata.description: Model experimental apparatus as system-of-systems graph with knowledge gap (System D)
workflow_metadata.purpose: Create machine-readable experimental_system_architecture.json defining Systems A, B, C, D (UNKNOWN), E and their physical interactions

workflow_steps.description: Define the energy/particle source (X-rays, photons, electrons, etc.)

actions.details: For each source: component_id, component_name, system_category='system_a_source', knowledge_state='KNOWN'
actions.prompt: What is your source? Examples: synchrotron undulator, laser, X-ray tube, neutron source

actions.details: Define KNOWN properties: energy range, flux/intensity, beam profile, polarization, temporal structure, etc.
If user doesn't know exact specs, use typical values for facility (e.g., NSLS2 undulator: 5-30 keV, 1e13 ph/s)

criteria: At least one System A component defined

workflow_steps.description: Define optical/mechanical components that manipulate, focus, or condition the source

actions.details: For each component: component_id, component_name, system_category='system_b_manipulation', knowledge_state='KNOWN'
actions.prompt: What optics/mechanics are in the beam path? Examples: monochromators, mirrors, lenses, slits, attenuators, focusing optics

actions.details: Properties: reflectivity, transmission, energy resolution, focal length, positioning accuracy, etc.
Create edges from System A to System B: interaction_type='source_to_manipulation', mechanism (transmission/reflection), observability='HIGH'

criteria: System B components defined (can be empty if direct source→sample)
Interactions from A to B defined

workflow_steps.description: Define environmental conditions affecting the sample

actions.details: For each: component_id, component_name, system_category='system_c_environment', knowledge_state='KNOWN'
actions.prompt: What environmental controls exist? Examples: temperature (cryostat/furnace), pressure (vacuum/gas), magnetic field, electric field

actions.details: Properties: temperature range, pressure range, field strength, stability, control precision, etc.
Create edges from System C to System D: interaction_type='environment_to_sample', mechanism (thermal coupling, mechanical stress, field coupling), observability='MEDIUM'
actions.output: Interactions C→D (will connect to System D in next step)

criteria: System C components defined (can be empty for room-temperature ambient experiments)
Environment→sample interactions defined if System C exists

workflow_steps.description: Define the sample/system under investigation as a knowledge gap

actions.details: component_id='sample_001', component_name='<user sample name>', system_category='system_d_sample', knowledge_state='UNKNOWN'
actions.prompt: Describe your sample briefly (e.g., 'Unknown crystalline oxide', 'Biological protein crystal', 'Thin film material')

actions.details: List properties as 'UNKNOWN' placeholders: crystal_structure='UNKNOWN', lattice_parameters='UNKNOWN', chemical_composition='UNKNOWN', etc. These are what gap closure will infer!
actions.prompt: What properties do you want to discover about the sample?
actions.output: System D properties (all UNKNOWN or PARTIALLY_KNOWN)

actions.details: Add 'gap_closure_goal' field describing what you want to infer from measurements
Create edges from System B (or A if no B) to System D: interaction_type='manipulation_to_sample', mechanism (irradiation, excitation, scattering), observability='MEDIUM'

criteria: At least one unknown property identified
Incoming interactions from A or B defined

actions.details: For each detector: component_id, component_name, system_category='system_e_detection', knowledge_state='KNOWN'
actions.prompt: What detectors are used? Examples: CCD camera, photodiode, spectrometer, scintillator, APD

actions.details: Properties: quantum efficiency, energy resolution, spatial resolution, temporal resolution, dynamic range, noise characteristics

actions.description: Define sample → detection interactions (CRITICAL FOR GAP CLOSURE)
actions.details: Create edges from System D to System E: interaction_type='sample_to_detection', mechanism (scattering, fluorescence, transmission), observability='HIGH', critical_for_gap_closure='TRUE'. THIS IS YOUR MEASURED DATA!
actions.output: Interactions D→E (this encodes System D in measurements)

actions.details: If direct beam measurement or reference detector exists, create B→E or A→E edges: interaction_type='manipulation_to_detection', observability='HIGH'

criteria: At least one System E component defined

workflow_steps.description: Review complete experimental system architecture and validate graph structure

actions.details: Create human-readable summary: # of components per system (A, B, C, D, E), total interactions, identified knowledge gaps
Check: (1) System D reachable from A (via B), (2) System D reaches E, (3) No isolated components, (4) At least one D→E interaction
Present architecture to user for approval. Ask: Does this accurately represent your experimental setup?
Save to specs/machine/experimental_systems/experimental_system_architecture.json with metadata (version, date, user, framework)

workflow_steps.description: Finalize modeling and prepare for gap discovery

actions.details: Set current_workflow='02-knowledge_gap_discovery', current_step='KG-01', increment operations_since_refresh
Create docs/modeling_report.md with: systems defined, interactions defined, knowledge gaps identified, readiness for gap closure
Ask: 'Experimental system modeled! Ready to discover knowledge gaps? Proceed to workflow 02-knowledge_gap_discovery.'

quality_gates.description: Verify experimental system architecture is complete and valid
criteria: All 5 systems (A, B, C, D, E) considered (C can be empty)
At least one D→E interaction exists
Graph is connected (A reaches D, D reaches E)
